summary.text: Kristie O'Brien is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Julie Willoughby with no incumbent in the race.

paragraphs.text: Kristie O'Brien previously ran for the Arizona State Senate in 2014, when she was unopposed in the Democratic primary for District 17.
She received 39.9 percent of the vote in the general election, losing to incumbent Republican Steve Yarbrough.
O'Brien advanced from the Democratic primary for Senate District 13 on July 21, 2026.
